outreach.notes: Awarded BOTH lots for the Expo 2027 COLLECTIVE PAVILIONS: design, engineering, construction, fit-out, operational management, maintenance and dismantling. Total RSD 5.28bn ex-VAT (approx EUR 45m), 6 bidders. Korean exhibition/museum builder (founded 1988, Seongnam), long World Expo track record. Highest-value prospect on the list: the collective pavilions are where the countries WITHOUT their own building exhibit, so this firm is the gatekeeper to a large share of booth-level participants. Source: b92.net/biz/srbija/vesti/255039 (2026-07-31).
